terminal_completion_summary: Verified 91 raw inputs, matched all 50 original raw/converted representations, reconstructed all original per-fact primary and influence-cosine contrasts to 1e-12, and completed separate original50 and expanded91 analyses plus fixed-parameter sensitivities.

top_probability_ties.handling: Stable raw archive order chooses ' a', matching the historical converter. Both tokens have the same broad output type. This is an invented-name control, so no factual eligibility gate is affected. Do not describe the selected token as uniquely preferred.

interpretation_notes: This is a late expanded observational analysis, not a new confirmatory sample or an independent replication. Original50 is nested within expanded91.

In eligibility tables, collection_rejections means November completion-attempt statuses for roles missing from the named cohort. Original50 rows can therefore show later saved/rejected statuses; this field is not evidence for why those original prompts were unscheduled in July.

leave_one_fact_out_primary_means deletes one already-computed fact margin while holding all comparator definitions fixed. It does not remove that fact from every remaining target's comparison pool and recompute the statistic.

Use cohort heldout_primary for the pooled primary interval and heldout_domains for the canonical domain-specific intervals. domain_split_summaries uses another fixed bootstrap seed; small Monte Carlo interval differences do not represent different estimates or cohorts.

The inherited empty-heldout permutation edge case was identified in machine code review but cannot affect this run: unchanged original chemistry contributes five included evaluation facts. Future reuse with an empty evaluation cohort must guard that case.

Failure of the exact expected-first-token rule is not proof of a wrong completed answer. In particular Mercury produces ' H' rather than the full expected 'Hg'; answer-prefix compatibility is not treated as passing the frozen rule.

Matched exporter/source names and recorded version labels do not prove that hosted weights or backend implementation remained unchanged. Old graphs include desired-logit coverage .95, whereas the late collection requested .99.
The negative same-wording invented-name control results and inconclusive coarse edge-flow result are retained; this analysis does not establish fact-specific semantic invariance.

Two hundred feature subsamples are algorithmic sensitivity draws, not 200 independent observations. Shared other-fact comparators limit the independence interpretation of fact bootstraps and sign-flip tests.
